name: J 光标
meaning: 把 J 和光标融合，直接表达桌面操作。
prompt: Design one original, production-quality application logo icon for Javis, a standalone cross-platform desktop computer-use agent. The product observes desktop app windows, takes screenshots and accurately operates controls with user authorization, preserving focus where possible. Create ONE centered icon only, not a presentation board. The actual icon should occupy a large rounded-square/squircle tile inset about 6% from the image edges with a plain very pale gray outer margin. The main symbol must be generous and readable at 32 pixels. Modern flat vector-like raster design, solid geometric shapes, excellent optical balance, large negative spaces, two or three colors maximum. No typography except a deliberately designed J where specified. No words, no labels, no watermark, no gradients, no metallic materials, no glass effects, no photorealism, no mockup, no shadows, no borders around the overall image. Do not imitate existing brand logos. Specific direction: An original monogram capital J merged with a computer arrow cursor. One bold cobalt-blue sculptural J, its top terminal forms an unmistakable diagonal pointer arrow, tiny ice-white negative-space cut. Pale cool ivory squircle tile. Precise geometric construction, memorable simple silhouette, professional developer tool.
